Synthetic hologram game. Not a hardware or biology validation.

Find the focus

Each level is a simulated off-axis hologram with an unknown reference phase and a fractional carrier, reconstructed by WaveHolo (wave_hologram.py). Scrub the depth slider through the reconstruction stack, find the plane where the object is sharpest, and lock it in. Your error is measured against the true synthetic distance, and then compared with WaveHolo's measured one.

Keyboard: focus the slider, use ←/→ (one frame, 0.1 mm), PageUp/PageDown (ten frames), Home/End, and Enter to lock in. Frames are 0.1 mm apart, so even a perfect pick can be up to 50 µm from the truth.

What this is. Five seeded, simulated scenes made with the same functions the README documents. The "true" distance is the simulated object distance. Nothing here is a hardware or biology result, and one scene per level says nothing about general performance. The answers are inside this page's data block, so it is a game, not a test.

Your best total is stored only in this browser (localStorage). The page makes no network requests. AGPL-3.0-only. Regenerate the frames with python3 scripts/make_game_frames.py.
